summary.text: Sheila Jones, a Democrat, represents District 60 in the Georgia House of Representatives and was elected in 2004.

paragraphs.text: According to her legislative biography, Jones worked for Lockheed Martin in Marietta and retired after 34 years.
The biography says she was also Legislative Representative for the Georgia State Council of Machinists & Aerospace Workers (AFL-CIO).
